SELECT 
    commregistry,
    vpnflag,
    tornodecount,
    encryptmethod,
    connpatscore,
    brwsrunique,
    CASE vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END AS vpnflag_numeric,
    CASE encryptmethod WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 2 WHEN 'Custom' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS encryptmethod_numeric,
    (CASE vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END) * 30 
    + (tornodecount * 2) 
    + (CASE encryptmethod WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 2 WHEN 'Custom' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) * 15 
    + (connpatscore * 0.2) 
    + (brwsrunique / 20.0) AS apl_score
FROM communication
ORDER BY apl_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    MIN(apl_score) AS min_apl,
    MAX(apl_score) AS max_apl,
    AVG(apl_score) AS avg_apl,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY apl_score) AS p25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY apl_score) AS median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY apl_score) AS p75
FROM (
    SELECT 
        (CASE vpnflag WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END) * 30 
        + (tornodecount * 2) 
        + (CASE encryptmethod WHEN 'Standard' THEN 1 WHEN 'Enhanced' THEN 2 WHEN 'Custom' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) * 15 
        + (connpatscore * 0.2) 
        + (brwsrunique / 20.0) AS apl_score
    FROM communication
) sub;
